narrator.description: calm, serious, documentary-style adult male voice, medium-deep, clear, a bit fast-paced, neutral accent (totally serious, which makes it funny)

recording.name: the supplied voiceover recording (all eight lines in one file)

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your little brother just ate three cans of beans. You have five minutes. Here's how to survive.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Dig a shelter, fast. But be careful: the worst smelly gas is heavier than air, so it sinks right into holes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So you need an airtight door, with rubber seals all around it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But you still need to breathe. So you add a tall pipe that takes clean air from high up, above the cloud.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then you add a carbon filter, the same thing used in gas masks. It traps the smell and lets clean air through.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And a fan pushes clean air in, so the pressure inside is higher. Now the gas can't sneak through any gaps.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Time's up. The cloud spreads fifty meters in every direction. But underground, you're completely safe.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Unless the danger is already inside.
